plan.notes: Official four-year plan page from Seattle University (College of Arts and Sciences), 2026-2027. Quarter-Based Degree Plan transcribed (for students who enroll prior to Summer 2027, i.e. current entrants; the semester plan applies from Summer 2027). All 12 quarters sum to 15 each; total 180 quarter credits matches the minimum to graduate. Curriculum notes: 15 cr of English electives at 3000-4000 level including 5 cr Pre-1800 Literature and 5 cr 1800-Present Literature; one course must be Context & Theory (CT); one must be Intercultural/Intersectional Literature (INT). Retrieved 2026-10-09.
